eq-ch14-launch-rank: Global block rank from process rank and local block index, and back.
eq-ch14-msgmatch-tag: Exchange message tag from the sync id, local block, buffer and variable index; it is one to one.
eq-ch14-restart-next: On resume, an output's next time is clamped to one interval ahead; a new output joins the grid at or below the restored time.
eq-ch14-schedule-moments: Time-weighted running mean and deviation of output statistics (weighted Welford recurrence).
eq-ch14-reflecting-parity: Reflecting wall ghosts: even components mirrored, normal velocity mirrored with a sign change.
eq-ch14-periodic-copy: Periodic ghosts copy the matching owned cells from the other end, an exact permutation.
eq-ch14-extrapolation-copy: Extrapolation ghosts repeat the nearest owned cell.
eq-ch14-outflow-modes: Outflow characteristic variables: the two acoustic combinations and the entropy perturbation.
eq-ch14-outflow-inverse: Inverse of the characteristic split after the incoming modes are set to zero.
eq-ch14-outflow-admissible: The outflow ghost state is the background plus one scaled perturbation that keeps it admissible.
eq-ch14-exchange-corner: A corner ghost is the average of the two adjacent edge strips.
eq-ch14-solids-dp: Dynamic-programming update of the minimum flip cost for rectifying a solid mask with minimum run lengths.
eq-ch14-solids-closure: Reflecting closure of a fluid face against a solid in the implicit system, folded into the diagonal block.
eq-ch14-wb-continuation: Wall continuation of the hydrostatic $\rho/p$ ratio, linear in $\chi$ or in $\log\chi$ by the slope sign.
eq-ch14-wb-parity: Wall ghosts mirror the pressure and density perturbations about the hydrostatic reference.
